name: Mirror / Invert Binary Tree
description: Creates a mirror image of a binary tree by swapping left and right children at every node recursively.
aim: Invert the binary tree by recursively swapping the left and right subtrees of every node using a simple post-order traversal.
howItWorks: Base case: null node returns null

whenToUse: Need mirror/reflection of a tree structure
alternatives: Iterative BFS — swap children level by level
